realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12dp / WP-S2c-79 uses the prior contiguous local data-year evaluation window, 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, as H-004 selected pre-WP-5b combined R1+R2 cycle 2 after WP-12do cycle 1 used 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 1d history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-004 REP-0005 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional pre-WP-5b runway evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: EXP-0005 requires OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0031 records sharpe above that threshold.
EXP-0005 requires dsr_val > 0.95; OL-0031 records dsr above that threshold.
EXP-0005 requires max drawdown <= 20%; OL-0031 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
EXP-0005 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0031 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
EXP-0005 requires cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL; OL-0031 records cost_drag_fraction above that threshold with positive gross PnL.
EXP-0005 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0031 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.
